summary: Research record for Sermorelin. Europe PMC indexes 579 publications, including 39 randomized controlled trials, as of 2026-09-14. Claims are pending human authorship and review.

seo.description: Cited overview of published Sermorelin research: 579 indexed publications, 39 randomized controlled trials. Evidence tier on every claim.

regulatory_status.value: ChEMBL CHEMBL1201490: maximum clinical phase 4, first approval 1990, ATC V04CD03, H01AC04. Jurisdiction-level status pending human review.
